snippet.title: BLUE SIGN | Official Trailer #1 | Coming AUG 14, 2026
snippet.description:
Become a maritime insurance underwriter during the Age of Sail.

Examine ships, cargo, routes, captains, and hidden risks. Decide which voyages deserve your signature—and live with the consequences of your judgment.

BLUE SIGN launches on Steam on AUG 14, 2026 at 4:00 PM KST.

Supported languages:
English / 한국어 / 日本語

Developed by BLUE ANEMOIA.

#BLUESIGN #IndieGame #Steam
